Class GamePageRenderer

java.lang.Object
com.cuseto.pong.view.GamePageRenderer
public final class GamePageRenderer extends Object
Composes the gameplay Scene: the PongRenderer canvas, with the PauseMenuRenderer and GameWinnerBannerRenderer overlaid on top when shown.

The pause menu and winner banner are added to and removed from the scene graph on demand via showPauseMenu()/hidePauseMenu() and showWinnerBanner(Player)/hideWinnerBanner(); each show/hide method is safe to call even if the overlay is already in the requested state.

      public GamePageRenderer(double windowWidth, double windowHeight, Runnable closeMenuFunction, Runnable exitGameFunction)
      Creates the gameplay scene at the given size, with the pause menu's close and exit actions wired to the given callbacks.
      Parameters:
      windowWidth - the scene width, in pixels
      windowHeight - the scene height, in pixels
      closeMenuFunction - the callback invoked when the pause menu's close action is triggered
      exitGameFunction - the callback invoked when the pause menu's exit action is triggered
